claim: First 20 minutes has one mandatory material/tool spine.
steps: Inspect FirstHourDirector and Quest_Graph; start fresh game; exit safe anchor; advance route.
pass_condition: Only titanium/copperwire/scanner candidate spine gates first-20 progression; copper-only sample is optional or subgate.

claim: Starter tool availability matches mandatory resource source.
steps: Inspect Player prefab/loadout/unlock source; attempt first titanium and copper collection without debug grants.
pass_condition: Required tool is assigned/unlocked before objective, or source uses valid starter interaction; no hidden debug route.

claim: Player can collect deterministic titanium from authored shallow route.
steps: From safe anchor, exit, reach first titanium source, harvest, return.
pass_condition: Inventory contains Data_TitaniumScrap; source scar/depletion visible; peak depth and O2 logged.

claim: Player can collect deterministic copper without violating CopperVein drill gate.
steps: From same route, collect first copper source; do not use CopperVein unless drill route exists.
pass_condition: Inventory contains Data_Copper; CopperVein remains Drill-gated; source is placed authored outcrop/cache/debris.

claim: Copper wire recipe consumes declared runtime ingredients.
steps: Declare recipe owner; craft copper wire in fabricator after route collection.
pass_condition: Runtime inventory delta matches owner recipe; Data/Economy and RecipeData mirrors agree or non-owner mirror is regenerated.

claim: Scanner prerequisite sensor package has explicit source.
steps: Inspect scanner recipe; collect/unlock sensor package through route or safe-anchor reward.
pass_condition: Comp_SensorPackage is available before scanner craft by authored non-random route.

claim: Scanner craft completes actual route-changing first craft.
steps: Craft scanner using real recipe owner after titanium/copperwire/sensor package gates.
pass_condition: Item_Tool_Scanner enters inventory; quest_first_hour_craft_scanner completes; scanner can scan a route/evidence target.

claim: Mandatory loop is survivable but oxygen-pressured.
steps: Start full O2; complete mandatory loop; record peak depth, minimum O2, route time, refill source.
pass_condition: Player returns alive with nonzero O2; overextension path can trigger warning/death; route does not require ugly sprinting.

claim: Compact lane keeps bright scenic photic route readable.
steps: Capture start, midpoint, resource source, return landmark at compact/low render settings.
pass_condition: Surface/photic route is bright, readable, premium, with landmark and unease; no darkness/fog concealment.

claim: Normal lane sells product identity above resource proof.
steps: Capture same route at normal tier.
pass_condition: Route shows beautiful shallows, industrial trace, resource affordance, and uneasy threat cue.

claim: Death after collection/craft cannot softlock first 20 minutes.
steps: Die carrying starter tools, titanium, copper, copper wire, scanner, and O2 support item.
pass_condition: Core tools retained; scanner retained or recoverable; loose resources dropped only to recoverable cache; quest state valid.

claim: Save/load preserves first-route decisions and scars.
steps: After collect/craft/death-cache scenario, save, reload, inspect state.
pass_condition: Inventory, quest flags, depleted source, route marker, and death cache persist with checksum-valid save.

claim: Survival/respawn failure is explainable from last 300 frames.
steps: Trigger O2 death or respawn penalty; inspect telemetry ring/dump fields.
pass_condition: Telemetry includes frame, AUP/depth, O2, route/source id, inventory drop count, respawn sequence, flags.

claim: First-route quest/resource/tool interactions do not allocate in hot paths.
steps: Run first-route loop with GC/profiler; scan for string/runtime lookup in hot paths.
pass_condition: 0 B/frame GC in route hot paths; no scene search/string lookup in interaction, quest, inventory, or survival ticks.
